Represents the relationship between a ReliabilityAssets in a geographical map.
This is used to generate the map view of the asset under "Asset Map" page.
This relation is "valid" whenever it meets the following conditions:
The from and to are different.
The from and to are ReliabilityAssets with geographical locations data.
Additionally this entity has a points field which is used to store the points that are used to draw the line
between the from and to assets, in case the relation is not a direct line.
For example, the following diagram shows a relations between 3 assets:
 Asset 0        @────@
  ▲   ▲         │    │
  │   │         │    │
  │   @─────────@    │
  │                  ▼
  │               Asset 2
  │
  │
  │
  ▼
Asset 1

In this case, Asset 0 --> Asset 1 has no points(@) and is a direct line. While Asset 0 --> Asset 2 has
4 points(@) and is not a direct line.
NOTE: All the connections in this graph are bidirectional, meaning that you can create a single relation
between Asset 0 and Asset 1 and it will be used to represent the connection in both directions.
